test_title: PYST 9 - SSC CHSL 2025 - English Language (Held On: 15 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct voice.**

He said to her that the film they had watched the previous night was not as good as he had expected it to be.

options.text: He said to her, "The film we watched last night was not as good as I expected it to be."
He said to her, "The film we had watched last night was not as good as I had expected it to be."
He said to her, "The film we watched the previous night was not as good as I expected it to be."
He said to her, "The film we had watched last night was not as good as I expected it to be."

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Indirect Speech:** He said to her that the film they had watched the previous night was not as good as he had expected it to be.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"the film they had watched the previous night" becomes "The film we watched last night"**
 
 
• Time expression "the previous night" is converted to "last night" to reflect direct speech.
 
• Pronoun "they" is changed to "we" to
